description:
A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores
  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Contratos para atuar na gestão contratual da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos. Essa posição será responsável por acompanhar o ciclo completo dos contratos, desde a elaboração e controle de requisições até o acompanhamento de execução, medição, faturamento e encerramento, garantindo conformidade técnica, financeira e regulatória.

Responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar contratos da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos, controlando saldos, prazos, cronogramas, escopos, desembolsos, aditivos, multas e cláusulas contratuais
  • Elaborar e acompanhar Requisições de Compra (RCs) de serviços e materiais
  • Revisar documentos técnicos como Memorial Descritivo (MD) e Planilha de Preços Unitários (PPU)
  • Acompanhar processos de compra junto à área de Suprimentos, assegurando fluxo de aprovações e avaliação técnica dos proponentes
  • Conduzir reuniões de Kick-off (KOM) com contratadas
  • Elaborar relatórios e dashboards de consumo contratual, prazos e status
  • Realizar boletins de medição, consolidar evidências, controlar assinaturas, emitir SES e acompanhar faturamento e pagamento
  • Atuar como interface técnica, jurídica e administrativa entre bases operacionais e áreas corporativas
  • Realizar reuniões de acompanhamento contratual com fornecedores
  • Garantir aderência orçamentária dos contratos sob sua responsabilidade
  • Assegurar conformidade das contratadas às políticas de segurança e compliance da companhia
Requisitos
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de contratos, compras e materiais, preferencialmente nos setores de óleo e gás ou infraestrutura
  • Conhecimento em SAP ou sistemas semelhantes de gestão de compras e contratos
  • Excel avançado
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de atuar com múltiplas interfaces
  • Prontidão para resolução de problemas e tomada de decisão
Diferenciais
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e ferramentas de análise de dados
  • Vivência com contratos de alta complexidade e gestão orçamentária
  • Experiência com políticas de compliance e segurança aplicadas à gestão contratual
Oferecemos
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa-auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio-medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale-presente, Vale-transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo
  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.
Etapas do Processo Seletivo
  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com os Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.
Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo. Oferecemos oportunidades reais de aprendizado e evolução profissional, com programas estruturados e incentivo ao protagonismo de carreira.

Benefícios
  • Plano de saúde de qualidade
  • Previdência privada
  • Vale refeição/alimentação (Swile)
  • Auxílio farmácia
  • Auxílio creche
  • Day-off de aniversário

Nossa Cultura

Colaboração: Compartilhamos conhecimento, trabalhamos em equipe, agimos com empatia, mantemos uma comunicação ativa e transparente.

Protagonismo: Somos criativos, adaptáveis e proativos, tomamos a iniciativa e assumimos a responsabilidade.

Sobre a equipe

Nossa equipe de Infraestrutura e Project Finance está buscando um(a) Advogado(a) Júnior para atuar no escritório do Rio de Janeiro.

Sobre a área

Nossa área de Infraestrutura e Financiamento de Projetos é formada por profissionais versáteis e com uma expertise diferenciada.

Nossa ampla gama de atuação e a experiência de nossos advogados nos dão uma visão única das questões e tendências regulatórias de setores e agências reguladoras brasileiras.

Nossa prática abrange desde o assessoramento a processos de licitação e apresentação de pleitos perante agências reguladoras, até a estruturação societária, contratual e financeira de projetos.

Temos uma equipe dedicada à negociação de contratos de infraestrutura, como EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction), offtake e O&M (Operação e Manutenção) e também assessoramos clientes com reivindicações durante a fase de construção.

Financiamento de projetos de infraestrutura tem sido uma das nossas principais especialidades desde nossa fundação.

Nossa equipe atuou em operações pioneiras, como, por exemplo, o primeiro project finance internacional limited-recourse para projeto greenfield, o primeiro project finance non recourse para produção de petróleo, o primeiro project bond internacional e o primeiro bond internacional lastreado em royalties de petróleo.

Entre nossos clientes estão as maiores instituições financeiras mundiais, bancos de desenvolvimento, agências multilaterais, agências de crédito à exportação (ECAs) e fundos de investimento, bem como os empreendedores, sponsors, offtakers e construtoras mais ativas e atuantes nesse mercado.

Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women’s Football Strategy.

  • Responsible for detailed planning and implementation of media facilities & services in the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 stadiums based on the FIFA HQ MEO strategy.

  • Define functional area’s Entity budget requirements and finalise budget reviews.
  • Manage, contribute, supervise the implementation of the scope and delivery of media-dedicated services, including technology, accommodation, accreditation, catering and transport.

  • Define and implement a rate card solution for International News Agencies and other key media outlets in coordination with technology.
  • Organise relevant workshops and meetings (media workshops, agency visits etc.)
  • Hire and deploy event-time staff – in coordination with FIFA Zurich HQ - Venue Media Managers & Venue Media Coordinators - in the various stadiums, managing all logistics and administrative tasks.
  • Event-time, manage and coordinate the venue media staff & services for all matches across the various venues.
  • Define and contribute to the information tools and supports (FIFA Media app content, media guide) for media in general, potentially other target groups on operations and services
  • Support the FIFA Media Department & Local Entity with media operations & services during events.
  • Contribute to the promotion of the tournament supporting FIFA and Local Entity departments involved
  • Manage planning, preparations and fulfilment of inspections to the FWWC 2027 stadiums and various other locations where media will be working
  • Participate in the development and management of trainings, workshops and production of information for media-related workforce and volunteers
  • Organises media conferences, media days and other media activities

Na CASSI somos movidos pelo propósito que é o de “Cuidar do participante em todas as fases da sua vida”, ainda que façamos parte de uma equipe de atividade meio ou fim, nosso propósito é único e sempre voltado ao participante da CASSI.

Por isso acreditamos que o (a) Médico (a) Cardiologista não é somente um cargo, mas participa ativamente da construção de estratégias para uma CASSI cada dia melhor.

Precisamos de pessoas que estejam dispostas a aprender e multiplicar conhecimento, avaliar e trocar ideias sobre o processo com a ótica de que podemos estar em constantes mudanças e melhorias.

Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão!

Todas as nossas vagas são abertas a pessoas de todos os perfis, incluindo pessoas com deficiência (PcD), pessoas negras, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+, 50+, entre outros grupos minorizados.

Caso você precise de algum recurso ou adaptação para participar do processo seletivo ou exercer suas atividades, por favor, informe no campo “Descrição das atividades”. Estamos comprometidos em oferecer um ambiente acessível e acolhedor para todos.

  • Realizar assistência médica respeitando as premissas do Código de Ética Médica.
  • Exercer atribuições conforme a política da CASSI.
  • Realizar consulta e atendimento médico, por meio de anamnese, exame físico, solicitação e análise de exames complementares conforme estratégias, programas e diretrizes da CASSI.
  • Emitir diagnósticos e aplicar recursos de medicina terapêutica e preventiva aos participantes.
  • Efetuar e requisitar exames complementares de acordo com os protocolos estabelecidos e necessidade dos participantes.
  • Interpretar resultados de exames de imagem, biométricos, hematológicos, bioquímicos e outros, comparando-os com os padrões normais com finalidade de emitir diagnóstico.
  • Indicar e prescrever medicamentos e terapias, visando à prevenção e tratamento de doenças assim como a manutenção e promoção da saúde
  • Emitir atestados de saúde e aptidão física e mental, quando necessário.
  • Emitir atestado médico com finalidade de afastamento das atividades habituais dos participantes, quando necessário.
  • Realizar registro dos pacientes examinados no prontuário eletrônico do participante (PEP), anotando a anamnese, exame-físico, resultados de exames, hipótese diagnóstica, tratamento, orientações e evolução da doença.
  • Ser, quando indicado pela CASSI, o responsável técnico em sua área de atribuição, perante órgãos diversos.
  • Realizar atendimento de urgência e emergência, sempre que necessário, no âmbito da CliniCASSI.
  • Realizar interconsulta com outros profissionais de saúde, sempre que necessário.

  • Realizar a notificação compulsória de doenças, sempre que necessário.
  • Participar de discussão de casos clínicos, sempre que necessário.
  • Participar de campanhas educativas nos campos da saúde pública e da medicina preventiva.
  • Prestar informações do processo saúde-doença aos participantes e a seus familiares.
  • Realizar diagnóstico da comunidade Cassi e levantar indicadores de saúde para avaliação do impacto das ações em saúde implementadas.

  • Utilizar equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI) conforme preconizado pela ANVISA.
  • Orientar os colaboradores que o auxiliam na execução das tarefas típicas do cargo.
  • Participar na elaboração do planejamento do serviço, seguindo as diretrizes da CASSI.
ATRIBUIÇÕES
  • Realizar atendimento médico aos participantes na área de cardiologia, seguindo protocolos e diretrizes da Cassi.

  • Realizar diagnóstico e propor tratamento para doenças cardiovasculares e propor alternativas para melhoria de vida.
  • Realizar acompanhamento dos participantes com doenças cardiovasculares e propor alternativas para melhoria da qualidade de vida.
  • Realizar avaliação pré-cirúrgicas dos participantes.
  • Realizar encaminhamento externo conforme oferta e tipo de serviço previamente pactuado com a APS seguindo linhas de cuidado e respeitando o rol de cobertura do plano.

Caixa de Assistência dos Funcionários do Banco do Brasil

A CASSI foi fundada em 27 de janeiro de 1944 por um grupo de funcionários do BB, com o objetivo de ressarcir as despesas de saúde dessa população. Nestas oito décadas, a Empresa experimentou grande desenvolvimento, tornando-se uma das maiores instituições sem fins lucrativos administradoras de planos de saúde do País. As 27 Unidades, instaladas em todos os Estados do País, proporcionam atendimento acolhedor e diferenciado.

O diferencial da Caixa de Assistência está na proposta de atendimento integral, focado na promoção da saúde e na prevenção de doenças, por meio da Estratégia Saúde da Família. Assim, é pioneira entre os planos de saúde brasileiros na oferta de programas e atividades coletivas em saúde, voltados para melhoria dos hábitos de vida, nutrição, atividade física, realização de consultas periódicas e exames de rotina, além de proporcionar o acompanhamento adequado dos portadores de doenças crônicas.

title: Engenheiro(A) De Serviços
description:
Resumo do cargo: O Engenheiro de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido. Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão: Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sitemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);
Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas, diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
Elaboração deprojetosbásicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
Análise de projetos eestudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
Serviços paraconfiguração, programação e atualização (i.E. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial. Quem você é: Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente. Para este cargo, você precisará: Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
Ter no mínimo6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
Capacidade deinterpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
Conhecimento avançadono pacote MS Office;
Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
Capacidade deespecificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado. Nossa cultura e compromisso com você: Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios. Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass);
seguro de vida;

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description: We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. Job Duties: You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process. Key Responsibilities: Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards. Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability. Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery. Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders. Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality. Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools. Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly. Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture. Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals. Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems. Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements. Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required. Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field. Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects. Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.Js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures. Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability. Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments. Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing). Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing). Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations. Nice to have: Postgraduate or Master’s degree. Spanish proficiency. IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles. Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization. Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.G., Kafka), and feature flag management. Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation .

title: Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions
description:
Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and.>

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions in various locations to drive partnerships for licensing and embedding Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro into software and SaaS solutions.

Canonical supports ISV customers and alliances in building on Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro, which helps them deliver fast, reliable, secure, compliant and consistent solutions.

We offer the world's most extensive base of open source software, backed by comprehensive SLA support, FIPS‑certified cryptographic compliance, and security commitments that meet HIPAA and FedRAMP standards. We are the top‑rated operating system for developers. Partnering with every major public cloud provider, we ensure Ubuntu is optimized and seamlessly integrated with their unique services, making it easier for ISVs to deploy solutions confidently across multi‑cloud environments. Additionally, we collaborate with leading server manufacturers, IoT providers, and silicon vendors to enable, optimize, and certify Ubuntu on their hardware. This makes Ubuntu an exceptional choice for ISVs selling physical appliances or traditional software solutions.

The world's biggest brands in AI build on these Ubuntu Pro capabilities to ensure they stay focused on their product proposition rather than maintenance or compliance.

Location

Multiple openings in the Americas and in E time zones.

Role Overview

The Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions will collaborate with Product, Alliances, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing colleagues to prospect into ISV accounts, introduce our offerings, and help partners or potential customers develop their products to best leverage our portfolio. The successful candidate will:

  • Drive embedded support and licensing sales with ISVs to exceed quarterly and annual booking targets.
  • Lead customer and partner relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales, customer success and support lifecycle.
  • Deepen understanding and engagement with the open source ecosystem.
  • Identify and develop partnerships that support Canonical's strategic ambitions.
  • Collaborate with product management to ensure fitness and enhancement of our platforms and solutions for ISVs.
  • Negotiate contracts with new and existing ISV partners and customers.
  • Shape our content and messaging for ISV partners and customers.

What We Are Looking For

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about an alternative chosen path.
  • Ability to establish strategic relationships with large organisations at all levels.
  • A passion for technology and extensive experience with the software and SaaS industry, Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred), the open source ecosystem, cloud models, and container service offerings.
  • Experience with lead generation and business development in the software sector.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
  • Outstanding business English writing and presentation skills.
  • A personal drive to meet commitments and a track record of delivering beyond expectations.
  • A commitment to leadership, skills development and mentorship.
  • An appreciation of diversity and effectiveness in a multicultural, multi‑national organisation.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

What We Offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Senior Legal Counsel (Chemicals and Retail) - Relocate to Saudi Arabia

Join to apply for the Senior Legal Counsel (Chemicals and Retail) - Relocate to Saudi Arabia role at ARAMCO .

Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world and a top global company by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced attorney to join the Chemicals & Retail Legal Practice of the Downstream Law Department within the Aramco Law Organization.

The Practice provides legal support to many downstream entities, primarily from a shareholder and governance perspective, with a focus on general corporate and commercial contracts.

As Counsel, your primary role is to provide legal advice to Saudi Aramco and its subsidiaries, particularly in the area of commercial agreements for the supply and offtake of Saudi Aramco’s wide array of products, including long‑term crude and product sales/placements, crude importation, long‑term refined product/chemical offtakes, processing/netting agreements, tolling arrangements and international hydrocarbon trading.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the corporate secretary for one or more entities, organizing and managing board meetings, and advising as to board authority and corporate governance matters.
  • Advise as to shareholder issues and manage the interface between the entity, the parent, and other affiliates.
  • Work closely with internal Saudi Aramco Downstream clients and support their substantial and complex contracting and purchasing functions.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate contracts, O&M agreements, service agreements, and other commercial contracts and related agreements, including complex products supply and offtake agreements.
  • Advise on internal policies, review and resolve claims, and provide training to company personnel on a variety of legal matters.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Law degree minimum; Master or Juris degree preferred.
  • Current admission to general practice before the highest court of the state or country of which you are a citizen or resident.
  • A minimum of 7 years progressive experience gained in a sophisticated law firm or corporation. A mix of private practice and in‑house experience would be preferred.
  • Relevant commercial contracts and general corporate experience, particularly in the downstream chemicals and retail sectors.
  • Excellent negotiation and communication skills.
  • Experience providing concise and clear support to clients and leadership, and mentorship experience.

Work Location and Work Schedule

Work Location: Within Saudi Arabia – to be specified in Job Offer.

Work Schedule: Full Time – to be specified in Job Offer.

Seniority Level

  • Mid-Senior level

Employment Type

  • Full‑time

Job Function

  • Legal

Industry

  • Oil and Gas

title: Chief Audit Officer
description:
Join to apply for the Chief Audit Officer role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Howard University is seeking a Chief Audit Officer (CAO) who serves as the institution’s senior audit executive, leading the internal audit function with authority and independence to provide objective assurance and advisory services across all university operations. The CAO plays a critical role in protecting institutional assets, enhancing operational effectiveness, and supporting the achievement of strategic objectives through systematic evaluation and improvement of risk management, internal controls, and governance processes.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Audit Execution

  • Develop and annually update a comprehensive, risk‑based internal audit plan aligned with the university’s strategic priorities, emerging risks, and compliance requirements
  • Present the annual audit plan to the Audit Committee for review and approval, adapting priorities dynamically in response to changing institutional needs
  • Direct and oversee all internal audit engagements, including financial, operational, compliance, information technology, and investigative audits
  • Ensure audit work is performed in accordance with the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards)
  • Implement and maintain a quality assurance and improvement program, including periodic external assessments
  • Coordinate audit activities with external auditors and regulatory agencies to maximize coverage and minimize redundancy

Reporting & Communication

  • Prepare and present comprehensive audit reports to the President, senior leadership, and Audit Committee, including findings, risk ratings, and actionable recommendations
  • Communicate significant risk exposures, control deficiencies, and governance concerns to the Audit Committee in a timely and transparent manner
  • Provide quarterly status reports on audit plan progress, emerging risks, follow‑up on prior recommendations, and resource utilization
  • Meet privately with the Audit Committee without management present to discuss sensitive matters
  • Review audit workpapers, findings, and reports to ensure quality, accuracy, and appropriate support for conclusions

Risk Management & Advisory Services

  • Conduct ongoing enterprise risk assessments in collaboration with senior leadership to identify and prioritize audit areas
  • Monitor the institutional risk environment, including emerging risks related to technology, cybersecurity, research integrity, Title IX, athletics, sponsored programs, and student services
  • Provide advisory services and consultation on new systems, processes, policies, and strategic initiatives from a risk and control perspective
  • Track regulatory and legal developments affecting higher education, including federal and state requirements, accreditation standards, and grant compliance
  • Facilitate training and awareness programs on internal controls, fraud prevention, ethics, and risk management

Investigations & Special Projects

  • Lead or oversee investigations into allegations of fraud, financial irregularities, policy violations, or misconduct with appropriate confidentiality and due process
  • Coordinate with Human Resources, General Counsel, and law enforcement as appropriate during investigations
  • Conduct special projects and ad hoc reviews at the request of the Audit Committee, President, or senior leadership

Independence & Professional Standards

  • Maintain organizational independence and individual objectivity in all audit activities, free from interference in determining scope, performing work, and communicating results
  • Uphold the IIA Code of Ethics and maintain professional skepticism in all engagements
  • Ensure the internal audit function has unrestricted access to records, personnel, and physical properties relevant to audit activities
  • Avoid conflicts of interest and recuse from audits where independence may be compromised

Team Leadership & External Coordination

  • Recruit, supervise, mentor, and evaluate internal audit staff, fostering professional development and maintaining a high‑performing team
  • Promote continuing professional education and certification for audit staff
  • Manage the internal audit budget and allocate resources effectively to achieve audit plan objectives
  • Serve as the primary liaison with external auditors for financial statement audits, federal compliance audits (Single Audit), and NCAA agreed‑upon procedures
  • Manage relationships with external firms engaged for specialized audits or consulting services

Qualifications

Education

  • Required: Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or related field
  • Preferred: Master's degree in accounting, business administration (MBA), public administration (MPA), or related discipline

Certifications

  • Required: At least one of the following professional certifications:
    • Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
    • Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
    • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
  • Preferred: Multiple relevant certifications demonstrating breadth of expertise

Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive internal audit experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership or management role
  • Demonstrated experience in higher education, public sector, nonprofit, or similarly complex organizational environments strongly preferred
  • Proven track record of developing and executing risk‑based audit plans and managing audit engagements from planning through reporting
  • Experience presenting audit findings and recommendations to audit committees or boards of directors

Knowledge & Skills

  • Comprehensive understanding of the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing and the COSO Internal Control Framework
  • Strong knowledge of governance, enterprise risk management, and compliance frameworks (e.g., COSO ERM, ISO 31000)
  • Familiarity with higher education regulations including Title IV financial aid, OMB Uniform Guidance, research compliance, NCAA rules, and FERPA
  • Proficiency in data analytics tools and audit management software
  • Understanding of information technology controls, cybersecurity risks, and IT audit methodologies
  • Knowledge of fraud detection and prevention techniques

Competencies

  • Leadership: Ability to lead and inspire a professional team, influence organizational change, and navigate complex institutional environments
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with ability to present complex information clearly to diverse audiences
  • Analytical Thinking: Strong critical thinking, problem‑solving, and analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Relationship Building: Diplomatic and collaborative approach, with ability to build trust and credibility across all organizational levels
  • Integrity: Unwavering commitment to ethical conduct, objectivity, and professional standards
  • Judgment: Sound decision‑making ability and professional skepticism, balanced with pragmatism and business acumen
  • Adaptability: Flexibility to manage changing priorities, emerging risks, and resource constraints in a dynamic environment

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Range: $240,000 - $260,000

About Solution Seeker

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

Our software streams live sensor data from production facilities worldwide, processed in an event-driven, distributed system using patented algorithms to identify stable periods and select the most valuable data points for our machine learning models.

On top of this, we develop applications that help customers visualize and contextualize their data with our predictions and analyses, enabling them to make better production decisions. Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese , both written and spoken (English will be your main working language)
  • Willingness to live 12 months in Oslo, Norway (from Feb 2026) and return to Rio to join the Brazilian team once your initial rotation is over.
  • Interest in digitalization, machine learning, and AI
  • Basic understanding of programming and strong logical reasoning skills
  • Ability to take initiative and deliver results
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Being Brazilian or possessing a valid work permit to work in Brazil (once your rotation in Oslo is over)
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field
  • Our tech stack is large and we do not expect you to know all of it, but any familiarity would be greatly appreciated skills
  • Familiarity with Python
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • Experience/knowledge of Plotly Dash
  • Experience studying or working abroad
  • Experience with simulation, optimization, and modeling
  • Master’s degree in engineering or a related field

What we offer

To give you the best possible start before joining our Rio de Janeiro team, you’ll spend your first year with us at our headquarters in Oslo, where you’ll get a full onboarding into the company, our people, and our way of working. We will provide assistance related to obtaining the necessary visas/work permits before you can relocate to Oslo, and we will offer a competitive remuneration package for your stay in Norway, so you can focus on learning, contributing to the company, and enjoying the experience.

At Solution Seeker, we believe work should be both meaningful and fun. You’ll have the freedom to shape your own workday, with opportunities to explore different teams and projects based on your interests.

Our culture is young, social, and collaborative—we enjoy lunch runs, after-work beers, company trips. Once back in Rio, you’ll carry that spirit with you, working closely with our Oslo team while enjoying the energy of our Brazilian office (and yes, the beaches are right there when you need them).

Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Legal Counsel to join the Gas Corporate & Commercial Legal Practice in the Upstream Law Department within the Aramco Law Organization.

  • Advise on claims management and dispute resolution processes.
  • Serve as Board Secretary for designated joint ventures and subsidiaries.
  • Manage relationships with external legal counsel, including oversight of legal budgets and service quality.

Required Qualifications

  • A Bachelor of Law degree as minimum. Master or Juris degree preferred.

  • A minimum of 10 years experience gained in a sophisticated law firm or corporation. Preferably within a major international or national energy company or oilfield services organization.

description:
Oil Reservoir Management Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Please note that this role is based in Saudi Arabia on a permanent, residential basis.

Overview

We are seeking an Oil Reservoir Management Engineer with extensive experience in Oil Reservoir Management to join our Exploration and Petroleum Engineering Center in Dhahran. Our Center provides expert advice and guidance on all aspects of oil reservoir management, including designing, participating in and implementing best‑in‑class reservoir management programs. This position is embedded within the Petroleum Engineering business and as a senior technical specialist, you will engage with leaders and experts from across the upstream business.

Your primary role is to manage some of the world’s largest onshore and offshore oil fields, conduct pioneering research, introduce new technologies and provide specialized engineering services as part of the customized reservoir management practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide guidance and oversight on best-in-class reservoir management tenets, practices and state of the art technologies for all Saudi Aramco hydrocarbon assets.
  • Formulate reservoir development, data acquisition, strategic surveillance and monitoring master-plans to ensure optimal development and depletion strategies.
  • Utilize reservoir management standards and guidelines to enhance both net present value and hydrocarbon recovery.
  • Lead, design and participate in integrated field reviews and field development plans.
  • Prepare reservoir engineering input into drilling and work-over proposals and programs.
  • Recommend advanced completion techniques for horizontal and multi-lateral wells.
  • Lead and participate in reservoir engineering studies that include reservoir stimulation modeling of various International Offshore Rule (IOR) processes for improvement of ultimate recovery.
  • Participate in technical societies and technical groups.

Qualifications

  • Hold a Bachelor degree in Petroleum Engineering or related discipline. A Master degree or PhD is desirable, but not required.
  • Have a minimum of 10 years related experience including at least 7 years specializing in oil reservoir management. A training history of appropriate specialized courses and seminars is expected. Technical publications are valued but in‑depth practical experience is paramount.
  • Must have full professional proficiency in English required to interact and communicate clearly with specialists in geology, core and fluid analysis, petrophysics, simulation, drilling, completion, production and facilities.
  • Must have working knowledge of open‑hole and cased‑hole logs, geological modeling, simulation, completion and production procedures and technologies.
  • Technical knowledge and expertise are required in formation evaluation, geological modeling, simulation, reservoir appraisal and field development planning, completion, production/injection procedures, strategy technologies, water flooding, reservoir surveillance, SCAL, PVT, geochemical analysis and fluid compatibility. Additionally, expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and data analytics are desirable but not required.
  • Must have history of using modern reservoir management practices for oil reservoirs.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly. At Aramco, our people work on truly world‑scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. We invest heavily in talent development and encourage continuous learning through extensive workforce development programs.

Join to apply for the Design Director, UI/UX & Brand role at Darkroom

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior‑level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e‑commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

description:
Rio de Janeiro/RJ
Código de referência: CE RJ24
Vaga Permanente

Segmento: Educação Infantil e Ensino Fundamental I

DESCRIÇÃO SINTÉTICA DO CARGO:

  • Responsabilizar-se, em parceria com as Coordenações Pedagógicas de Segmento, pelo planejamento e implantação da proposta pedagógica;
  • Realizar a gestão da sua unidade de negócio (segmento) garantindo a sustentabilidade e os resultados, considerando a excelência acadêmica;
  • Acompanhar os processos de ensino e de aprendizagem em parceria com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento dos alunos nos níveis cognitivo, psicosexual, afetivo e social;
  • Promover a parceria Escola/Família.

ATRIBUIÇÕES

1.Acompanhar os processos de ensino e de aprendizagem em parceria com a equipe pedagógica, com foco nos resultados garantindo a implementação da proposta pedagógica:

1.1 – Implementa, junto com a equipe pedagógica, o planejamento anual em conformidade com o projeto pedagógico do colégio.
1.2 – Participa, junto ao Serviço de Orientação Religiosa, do planejamento dos dias de formação e convivência.

1.3 – Colabora com informações relevantes no processo de avaliação de professores, em parceria com as CPS’s , a partir do acompanhamento realizado aos estudantes.
1.4 – Promove estudos que propiciem a qualificação e atuação dos Auxiliares de Disciplina.
1.5 – Responsabiliza-se pelo processo de enturmação de estudantes.

1.6 – Mantém parceria constante com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento quanto ao processo de intervenção e acompanhamento dos estudantes junto aos professores.
1.7 – Elaborar em parceria com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento os processos de organização dos Conselhos de Classe.

1.8 – Conduz os Conselhos de Classe, orientando as discussões.

1.9 – Cumpre o Plano de Metas estabelecido a partir da Avaliação de Desempenho.

2 – Realizar gestão de processos relacionados ao desenvolvimento da aprendizagem dos estudantes considerando a excelência acadêmica:

2.1. Prioriza no plano operacional da unidade, as atividades específicas de sua função conforme a proposta pedagógica..
2.2. Estabelece foco na condução profissional das suas atividades.
2.3. Monitora o andamento da realização do plano de ação, visando à revisão de estratégias em tempo hábil.

2.4. Realiza análises quantitativas e qualitativas para respaldar as ações de intervenção junto aos alunos e às famílias.
2.5. Implementa ações que propiciem o processo de autorregulação de aprendizagem.
2.6. Orienta os professores para o acompanhamento do desempenho dos estudantes, especialmente aqueles com necessidades educativas especiais.

2.7.Efetiva projetos de formação de liderança e protagonismo juvenil em parceria com a coordenação do SOR.
2.8. Sistematiza processo de autoavaliação dos estudantes.
2.9 .Realiza projetos, junto aos estudantes, a partir de uma visão integradora dos segmentos.

2.10. Registra os processos sob sua responsabilidade.

2.11. Acompanha o desenvolvimento da aquisição das habilidades cognitivas dos estudantes, incentivando-os na construção dos hábitos de estudos.
2.12. Monitora criteriosamente o trabalho dos Auxiliares de Disciplina.
2.13. Zela pelo cumprimento dos códigos de disciplina e ética dentro da escola.

3 – Promover a parceria Escola/Família na condução do processo educacional :

3.1 – Colabora com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento na realização de reuniões com os pais.
3.2 – Inova no atendimento às famílias buscando a fidelização dos estudantes.
3.3 – Estrutura com a equipe pedagógica uma linha de ação para a inclusão dos estudantes com necessidades educativas especiais e suas famílias.

3.4 – Colabora na acolhida e orientação dos estudantes novatos.
3.5 – Encaminha às famílias, por escrito, quaisquer medidas disciplinares adotadas pela unidade em relação ao estudante.

– Conhecimentos na área pedagógica adquiridos em pós graduação lato sensu.
– Conhecimentos na área de neurociências adquiridos em pós graduação lato sensu.

– Conhecimento tecnológico.
– Gestão de projetos.
– Processos relacionados à metacognição e à autorregulação.
– Gestão de conflitos.

title: MSF Access Executive Director
description:
Location: Strong preference to be based in one of the five MSF Access Regional Hubs (Rio de Janeiro, Dakar, Brussels, Nairobi, and Kuala Lumpur). Placement in associated strategic locations may be considered.

Duration: MSF office contract, minimum 3 years commitment, extendable by 3 years, according to MSF practice and subject to national labour laws

Deadline to Apply:

Compensation and benefits: MSF practice is to offer the C&B package current in the MSF entity establishing the contract.

Reporting to: The MSF Access Executive Board

Start date: Beginning of Q2 2026 preferred with some flexibility depending on individual circumstances

MSF INTERNATIONAL

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 28 associations and other offices together. Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement, and implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND

Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign. In 2023, MSF’s International General Assembly unanimously voted a Vision that is anchoring addressing Access to Products Healthcare as being integral to its Social Mission:

“Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in-depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work.”

Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities. While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF’s access work. The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs: Kuala Lumpur, Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION

The Executive Director (ED) will be accountable to the MSF Access Executive Board for the proper oversight and management of the MSF Access resources and the execution of MSF Access’s mandate.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

The ED is responsible for the overall strategic, institutional, and representational leadership of MSF Access. The focus of the ED’s role will be on shepherding the vision, strategy, management, external engagement of MSF Access. Working closely with the Deputy Executive Director (DED), the ED focuses on strategic direction, high-level external representation and engagement, and internal governance and institutional management while the DED ensures medical relevance, rigour and operational grounding.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Executive Director’s primary responsibilities will include:

Strategic Leadership, Governance and Accountability

  • Implementation of the strategy vision of MSF Access

  • Leading development, implementation, monitoring and periodic revision of the MSF Access Strategic Plan by means of the annual/multi-year plan and budget

  • Executive leadership of the MSF Access team, including management of the MSF Access management team alongside the Deputy Executive Director

  • Final responsibility for, ongoing engagement with and reporting on the strategic progress, performance, annual budgets and expenditures, and risk mitigation strategies of MSF Access to the Executive Board, and when necessary, other MSF leadership and decision-making platforms such as the Full Executive Committee

  • Promoting processes for reflection, learning and continuous improvement across MSF Access

External Representation and Engagement

  • Representation of MSF Access in critical high-level global health and access discussions including in multilateral fora and processes, in government engagements where requested, with private sector leaders and other relevant stakeholders alongside the MSF Access MT

  • Steer MSF Access’s overall external partnership strategy in alignment with the broader MSF Access strategy and cultivate engagement with key global health and access stakeholders

Internal Leadership and Management

  • Management and coordination of key MSF Access functions (as articulated below) alongside the management team

  • Report to the MSF Access Board on key strategic and governance decisions and with informational updates of note, including but not limited to, major decisions relating to the content of MSF’s Access work, any material engagement with MSF leadership and governance structures, management of the MSF Access MT along with the DED, regular budgetary updates and accountabilities, and alongside the Head of Human Resources any HR issues requiring the attention of the board.

  • Alongside the DED and management team, translating the MSF Access Strategic Plan into annual plans for each respective body of work, including through individual projects and initiatives

  • Oversee development of MSF Access administrative policies and processes and addressing critical human resources issues

  • Development and finalization of the MSF Access annual plan and budget alongside relevant members of the management team

  • Representing MSF Access on the Medical Operational (MedOps) platform (which includes all medical directors and directors of operations across MSF) including participation in MedOps meetings as required

The ED is also responsible for ensuring that MSF Access fulfils its articulated responsibilities to the movement, which are:

  • Advise the Movement on the Common Priorities

  • Provide or source support on access issues to all entities that request it within MSF

  • Design and implement access initiatives to respond to the Common Priorities

  • Maintain an overview and report on access initiatives movement-wide on an annual basis

  • Survey and analyze the external access landscape

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 15+ years of senior management and leadership experience in global health policy, advocacy, institutional management, or humanitarian affairs

  • PhD or Master’s degree in health sciences (medical, (bio)medical, pharmacy) or international relations, public policy, public administration, public health with significant experience working in and knowledge of global health and access issues.

  • Demonstrated experience in global health and access issues in a broad range of subjects relevant to MSF’s medical humanitarian mission and operations.

  • Deep understanding of MSF’s operational and medical nature and its medical humanitarian mission.

  • Advanced managerial capabilities and experience with excellent project management capabilities, multidisciplinary teams and ability to work effectively and independently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience in developing and maintaining professional relationships with a wide range of stakeholders and organizations, including government officials, multilateral representatives, medical professionals, civil society, community organizations, academia, and global health donor organizations.

  • Experience in strategy development processes and demonstrated strategic thinking capabilities.

  • Proven track record of external engagements and external representation; ability to actively participate in public speaking engagements, including—but not limited to—presenting at conferences, conducting print and broadcast media interviews, and representation in external meetings.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated.

We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process.

Note: All offers of employment will be subject to reference checks and to appropriate screening checks. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms his/her/their understanding of these recruitment procedures.

Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement, and implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND

Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign. In 2023, MSF’s International General Assembly unanimously voted a Vision that is anchoring addressing Access to Products Healthcare as being integral to its Social Mission:

"Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in-depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work."

Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities. While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF’s access work. The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs: Kuala Lumpur, Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION

The Executive Director (ED) will be accountable to the MSF Access Executive Board for the proper oversight and management of the MSF Access resources and the execution of MSF Access’s mandate.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

The ED is responsible for the overall strategic, institutional, and representational leadership of MSF Access. The focus of the ED’s role will be on shepherding the vision, strategy, management, external engagement of MSF Access. Working closely with the Deputy Executive Director (DED), the ED focuses on strategic direction, high-level external representation and engagement, and internal governance and institutional management while the DED ensures medical relevance, rigour and operational grounding.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Executive Director’s primary responsibilities will include:

Strategic Leadership, Governance and Accountability

  • Implementation of the strategy vision of MSF Access
  • Leading development, implementation, monitoring and periodic revision of the MSF Access Strategic Plan by means of the annual/multi-year plan and budget
  • Executive leadership of the MSF Access team, including management of the MSF Access management team alongside the Deputy Executive Director
  • Final responsibility for, ongoing engagement with and reporting on the strategic progress, performance, annual budgets and expenditures, and risk mitigation strategies of MSF Access to the Executive Board, and when necessary, other MSF leadership and decision-making platforms such as the Full Executive Committee
  • Promoting processes for reflection, learning and continuous improvement across MSF Access External Representation and Engagement
  • Representation of MSF Access in critical high-level global health and access discussions including in multilateral fora and processes, in government engagements where requested, with private sector leaders and other relevant stakeholders alongside the MSF Access MT
  • Steer MSF Access’s overall external partnership strategy in alignment with the broader MSF Access strategy and cultivate engagement with key global health and access stakeholders
  • Management and coordination of key MSF Access functions (as articulated below) alongside the management team
  • Report to the MSF Access Board on key strategic and governance decisions and with informational updates of note, including but not limited to, major decisions relating to the content of MSF’s Access work, any material engagement with MSF leadership and governance structures, management of the MSF Access MT along with the DED, regular budgetary updates and accountabilities, and alongside the Head of Human Resources any HR issues requiring the attention of the board.
  • Alongside the DED and management team, translating the MSF Access Strategic Plan into annual plans for each respective body of work, including through individual projects and initiatives
  • Oversee development of MSF Access administrative policies and processes and addressing critical human resources issues
  • Development and finalization of the MSF Access annual plan and budget alongside relevant members of the management team
  • Representing MSF Access on the Medical Operational (MedOps) platform (which includes all medical directors and directors of operations across MSF) including participation in MedOps meetings as required

The ED is also responsible for ensuring that MSF Access fulfils its articulated responsibilities to the movement, which are:

  • Advise the Movement on the Common Priorities
  • Provide or source support on access issues to all entities that request it within MSF
  • Design and implement access initiatives to respond to the Common Priorities
  • Maintain an overview and report on access initiatives movement-wide on an annual basis
  • Survey and analyze the external access landscape

REQUIREMENTS

  • 15+ years of senior management and leadership experience in global health policy, advocacy, institutional management, or humanitarian affairs
  • PhD or Master’s degree in health sciences (medical, (bio)medical, pharmacy) or international relations, public policy, public administration, public health with significant experience working in and knowledge of global health and access issues.
  • Demonstrated experience in global health and access issues in a broad range of subjects relevant to MSF’s medical humanitarian mission and operations.
  • Deep understanding of MSF’s operational and medical nature and its medical humanitarian mission.
  • Advanced managerial capabilities and experience with excellent project management capabilities, multidisciplinary teams and ability to work effectively and independently in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Experience in developing and maintaining professional relationships with a wide range of stakeholders and organizations, including government officials, multilateral representatives, medical professionals, civil society, community organizations, academia, and global health donor organizations.
  • Experience in strategy development processes and demonstrated strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Proven track record of external engagements and external representation; ability to actively participate in public speaking engagements, including—but not limited to—presenting at conferences, conducting print and broadcast media interviews, and representation in external meetings.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated.
