This global leadership role in cyber security is to manage the Security Operations (SecOps) team responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.
As a leader on cyber security in the company, the SecOps team manager will collaborate with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate SecOps training across Canonical. They will operate in a wider security organisation, run a high performing security team and improve Canonical's security posture. They will lead initiatives to integrate the team's insights into Canonical's broader software development process.
While this is a management position, we expect managers to be expert practitioners, able to lead by example, contribute at the highest level, and assess work based on their own professional experience and skill. Candidates should have deep, hands-on expertise with a range of open source and proprietary security tooling and practices, which they can integrate into a holistic next generation security solution across the breadth of Canonical's interests.
The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.
This role reports to the CISO.
What you will do in this role:

  • Hire and mentor a team of outstanding technical security professionals
  • Define Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Own and drive the architecture and design of the SOC
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change
What we are looking for
  • Proven track record of mitigating with advanced threat actors and nation state threats
  • Expert technical understanding of SOCs from the ground up
  • In depth knowledge of SOC architecture and design including strategies for logging, firewalls, network segmentation, honeypots etc
  • Someone who understands how the SOC works not just how to use it
  • Expert in Linux security
  • Ability to define, implement, automate and measure effective incident response playbooks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Confidence to report security performance metrics with accountability for accuracy and completeness
Optional things we value
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with open source security tools
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001
  • Experience with security posture management of corporate endpoitns

Quem Somos

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito: Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito: Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência. Valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, e comprometemo-nos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.

Diversidade e inclusão: A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Construímos a cada dia uma cultura baseada no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência.

title: Cargo Supervisor
description:
About Us

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with advancing our core: continuing to advance the decarbonisation of traditional energy production. While pioneering more: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably.

Reports To

Cargo Superintendent (see Unit HSEP Shipboard Manual, Organization Chart for local variations)

Background

  • The Cargo Supervisor will exhibit a high standard of leadership, supervisory and safety behaviours and will ensure that all aspects of cargo and cargo utility systems operations and supervision are carried out effectively. Delegated tasks will be monitored and controlled formally and effectively.
  • Equivalent to Ballast Control Operator (BCO) as per Res. A.1079(28) Reg. 6.4.

Authority

  • The Cargo Supervisor assumes delegated authority for marine activities such as cargo loading and offloading and cargo utilities and maintenance. He or she will work with the Cargo Superintendent and the OIM as required where the safety of the crew and vessel is concerned. Work authority is delegated to competent personnel as appropriate.

Immediate Subordinates

  • Cargo Operators, GP Foremen, Crane Drivers, Visitors, and Sub‑Contractors.

Accountable For – Responsibilities & Standards

  • 1) Cargo Operations
  • Prepare to Start Marine and Cargo Operations
  • Startup Marine and Cargo Operations
  • Monitor and Maintain Marine and Cargo Operations
  • Prepare and shutdown Marine and Cargo Operations
  • Contribute to Tank Entry, Inspection and Maintenance Activities
  • 2) Manage and Supervise Effectively
  • Demonstrate leadership in technical and safety issues.
  • Liaise effectively with all relevant onshore and offshore departments.
  • Delegate authority having due regard for competence and verify effective close out of tasks.
  • Promote training and competency assurance throughout the department in line with company goals for the unit.
  • Promote safety awareness and application of the management system regarding immediate safety of personnel (PTW/Risk assessments/inspections).
  • Ensure timely and effective close‑out of relevant survey and audit action items.
  • Encourage and support all department personnel to achieve training and competency targets and plan for appropriate time allocation for this area of work.
  • Ensure timely and effective contributions to reporting and investigation of all incidents where required.
  • 3) Contribute to the Control of Critical Situations and Respond to Emergencies
  • Developing critical situations (operational, weather, equipment failure, leaks, fires, personnel etc.) are identified and positive action is taken to limit escalation and to maintain control using applied policies or procedures or initiative.
  • Manage emergency response with due regard for safety of personnel, FSO/FPSO and environment.
  • Demonstrate knowledge and awareness of potential emergency scenarios.
  • Contribute to the effective de‑brief and analysis of exercises.
  • 4) Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures
  • Controlled process discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits.
  • Unplanned discharges are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to policy, procedure and regulation.
  • Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
  • 5) Emergency Response
  • Carry out emergency response role (see Station Bill).
  • Demonstrate competence in emergency response drills and exercises.

Recruitment Only – Functional Competencies

  • Offshore – Perform lifeboat maintenance
  • Offshore – Manage supply and crew boat operations
  • Offshore – Monitor weather condition
  • Offshore – Plant and vessel knowledge
  • Offshore – Crane operations, rigging and lifting operations
  • Offshore – Safety management – HOD
  • Offshore – Define hull integrity management
  • Offshore – Tanker terminal
  • Offshore – Manage cargo export

Pre‑Hire Qualifications and Experience

  • Minimum qualifications as per STCW II/2 Chief Officer of ships of 3000gt or more.
  • 3 years crude oil tanker experience (VLCC preferable) as OOW (Officer on Watch); chief officer experience desirable.
  • Previous FPSO experience would be an advantage.
  • Use and experience with loading computer software.
  • Proficiency in English at a minimum of B1 level according to the CEFR international standard.
  • Medically fit according to the company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

General Information

SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). For further information, please visit our website at .

SBM Offshore is proud to be an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer. SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non‑disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Na CASSI somos movidos pelo propósito que é o de “Cuidar do participante em todas as fases da sua vida”, ainda que façamos parte de uma equipe de atividade meio ou fim, nosso propósito é único e sempre voltado ao participante da CASSI.

Por isso acreditamos que o (a) Médico (a) Cardiologista não é somente um cargo, mas participa ativamente da construção de estratégias para uma CASSI cada dia melhor.

Precisamos de pessoas que estejam dispostas a aprender e multiplicar conhecimento, avaliar e trocar ideias sobre o processo com a ótica de que podemos estar em constantes mudanças e melhorias.

Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão!

Todas as nossas vagas são abertas a pessoas de todos os perfis, incluindo pessoas com deficiência (PcD), pessoas negras, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+, 50+, entre outros grupos minorizados.

Caso você precise de algum recurso ou adaptação para participar do processo seletivo ou exercer suas atividades, por favor, informe no campo “Descrição das atividades”. Estamos comprometidos em oferecer um ambiente acessível e acolhedor para todos.

  • Realizar assistência médica respeitando as premissas do Código de Ética Médica.
  • Exercer atribuições conforme a política da CASSI.
  • Realizar consulta e atendimento médico, por meio de anamnese, exame físico, solicitação e análise de exames complementares conforme estratégias, programas e diretrizes da CASSI.
  • Emitir diagnósticos e aplicar recursos de medicina terapêutica e preventiva aos participantes.
  • Efetuar e requisitar exames complementares de acordo com os protocolos estabelecidos e necessidade dos participantes.
  • Interpretar resultados de exames de imagem, biométricos, hematológicos, bioquímicos e outros, comparando-os com os padrões normais com finalidade de emitir diagnóstico.
  • Indicar e prescrever medicamentos e terapias, visando à prevenção e tratamento de doenças assim como a manutenção e promoção da saúde
  • Emitir atestados de saúde e aptidão física e mental, quando necessário.
  • Emitir atestado médico com finalidade de afastamento das atividades habituais dos participantes, quando necessário.
  • Realizar registro dos pacientes examinados no prontuário eletrônico do participante (PEP), anotando a anamnese, exame-físico, resultados de exames, hipótese diagnóstica, tratamento, orientações e evolução da doença.
  • Ser, quando indicado pela CASSI, o responsável técnico em sua área de atribuição, perante órgãos diversos.
  • Realizar atendimento de urgência e emergência, sempre que necessário, no âmbito da CliniCASSI.
  • Realizar interconsulta com outros profissionais de saúde, sempre que necessário.
  • Participar de programas e atividades de educação em saúde, articulado com equipe da APS, com vistas à melhoria da saúde do participante.
  • Elaborar relatórios e laudos técnicos em sua área de especialidade, sempre que necessário.
  • Realizar a notificação compulsória de doenças, sempre que necessário.
  • Participar de discussão de casos clínicos, sempre que necessário.
  • Participar de campanhas educativas nos campos da saúde pública e da medicina preventiva.
  • Prestar informações do processo saúde-doença aos participantes e a seus familiares.
  • Realizar diagnóstico da comunidade Cassi e levantar indicadores de saúde para avaliação do impacto das ações em saúde implementadas.
  • Orientar e zelar pela preservação e guarda dos equipamentos, aparelhos e instrumentais utilizados em sua especialidade, observando a sua correta utilização.
  • Utilizar equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI) conforme preconizado pela ANVISA.
  • Orientar os colaboradores que o auxiliam na execução das tarefas típicas do cargo.
  • Participar na elaboração do planejamento do serviço, seguindo as diretrizes da CASSI.

ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Realizar atendimento médico aos participantes na área de cardiologia, seguindo protocolos e diretrizes da Cassi.
  • Realizar suporte técnico (preceptoria, interconsulta discussão de caso e elaboração de protocolos) às equipes da APS na área de cardiologia.
  • Realizar diagnóstico e propor tratamento para doenças cardiovasculares e propor alternativas para melhoria de vida.
  • Realizar acompanhamento dos participantes com doenças cardiovasculares e propor alternativas para melhoria da qualidade de vida.
  • Realizar avaliação pré-cirúrgicas dos participantes.
  • Realizar encaminhamento externo conforme oferta e tipo de serviço previamente pactuado com a APS seguindo linhas de cuidado e respeitando o rol de cobertura do plano.
  • Referenciar primeiramente os profissionais da APS para quaisquer novos problemas de saúde identificados.
  • Ensino Superior completo em Medicina
  • Registro no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM).
  • Residência Médica em Cardiologia ou Título de Especialista em Cardiologia com Registro de Qualificação de Especialista (RQE) emitido pelo CRM.
  • Experiência na área de Cardiologia.

  • Salário: R$ 11.396,86 (após o período de experiência)
  • Carga horária: 20 horas semanais
  • Cesta alimentação: R$ 498,48

  • Plano de saúde

  • Oferecemos licença maternidade de até 6 meses
  • Licença paternidade de até 20 dias

Caixa de Assistência dos Funcionários do Banco do Brasil

A CASSI foi fundada em 27 de janeiro de 1944 por um grupo de funcionários do BB, com o objetivo de ressarcir as despesas de saúde dessa população. Nestas oito décadas, a Empresa experimentou grande desenvolvimento, tornando-se uma das maiores instituições sem fins lucrativos administradoras de planos de saúde do País. As 27 Unidades, instaladas em todos os Estados do País, proporcionam atendimento acolhedor e diferenciado.

O diferencial da Caixa de Assistência está na proposta de atendimento integral, focado na promoção da saúde e na prevenção de doenças, por meio da Estratégia Saúde da Família. Assim, é pioneira entre os planos de saúde brasileiros na oferta de programas e atividades coletivas em saúde, voltados para melhoria dos hábitos de vida, nutrição, atividade física, realização de consultas periódicas e exames de rotina, além de proporcionar o acompanhamento adequado dos portadores de doenças crônicas.

Supervisor (a) de Produção - Programa de Desenvolvimento Acelerado

KEY EXPECTED ACHIEVEMENTS

The Business Unit Leader leads their team towards success in creating sustainable people, profit, and planet value, by adopting the following roles:

  1. Member of the Operations team: the Business Unit Leader aspires to drive the performance of the Shop first, even before their own Business Unit. For this, they are actively involved in:
    • Sharing best practices between Business Units and helping to contribute to the Plant performance in a collaborative manner. We maintain a mindset of “ONE MANUFACTURING TEAM” in all situations.
    • Detecting & developing talents that will grow their career in the Shop. They develop and export talent from their Business Unit to other activities to support business needs.
    • Supporting Shop decisions even when uncertainty and unfavorable circumstances may impact their own Business Unit.
    • Improve the performance of the Business Unit through regular coaching and feedback of support team members.
    • Provide input on the performance of support team members as well as recommendations for development.
  2. People developer: the Business Unit Leader is animated with the passion for people development, seeing their plant as a platform to recruit, train & offer professional growth for everyone in their teams. The Business Unit Leader is expected to:
    • Deploy a life-long learning mindset in the teams, through evaluation of competencies and identifying development opportunities to close the gaps.
    • Ensure the development of people through the avenue of Spoke training by support teams or through social promotion projects.
    • Utilize career paths accessible for all their employees.
    • Build and believe in the value of diverse teams.
    • Support competency development through mentoring & coaching.
  3. Representative/Role model of the Company values, purpose & strategy: the Business Unit Leader represents the Plant for the employees. They embody the group values by:
    • Consistently living out the values and acting as an example to inspire their employees by their behaviors.
    • Motivating their teams by leveraging the Michelin purpose & Dream.
    • Making sure that everyone in their Team understands the Plant strategy and understands the role that they play in the collective success of the vision.
    • Aligning the vision at the shop level and engaging the teams to make that vision a reality at the site.
    • Embody the values of the Company by ensuring employee issues are addressed in a timely fashion. Ensure accurate, on-time completion of time and attendance for employees and address attendance issues in a timely fashion.
    • Developing Safety as a value in the Business Unit, such that each employee is responsible for their safety and the safety of others.
  4. Customer & business partner: the Business Unit Leader understands the customers’ needs and the business stakes and guide the teams to be customer centric. The Business Unit Leader is expected to:
    • Develop an understanding of the Customer/partners and their requirements and the role their Business Unit has in meeting their expectations.
    • Steer their Business Unit, focused on all dimensions of economic value creation.
    • Support the business through a cooperation with local teams for: industrializations, modifications, digitalization, Industry transformations, etc.
  5. Environment promoter: the Business Unit Leader is viewed as an active promoter and influencer for continuous improvement in the environmental impact of their Business Unit by:
    • Promoting a culture that is aware and values sustainability and environment.
    • Complying/Implementing the strategy for environmental impact and biodiversity.

CARE AREA of EXCELLENCE

  1. ICARE & Empowerment role model: the Business Unit Leader is visibly striving to lead with the ICARE leadership model and inspires and coaches their team to progress in that direction. The Business Unit Leader is expected to:
    • Inspire and transfer their passion for ICARE to all employees at all levels, through the animation of a continuous deployment of the model in their Business Unit.
    • Create the condition for inclusion, safe-space, collaboration & collective intelligence in their team.
    • Foster empowerment through the engagement of their shop Support Teams, so that everyone can feel responsible for the plant’s future and fully take part in the evolution and transformation.
  2. Operational Excellence Leader: the Business Unit Leader is committed to develop the operational excellence by ensuring that:
    • Activities are driven by applying MMW(MDP+OR/MAPP), because the teams understand the value of such practices of excellence. Foundations are sustained over time, in order to create the conditions to achieve industrial performance.
    • The driving of continuous progress in the Business Unit, looking for variation reduction and non-added value tasks reduction, is vigorous.
    • Achieve Business Unit SMQDC expected performance levels and respect of standards to satisfy customer demand.
    • The team and its members are empowered and visibly committed. Autonomy increases through the evolution of polyvalence, competencies and responsibility.
    • Uses sound problem solving methodology to eliminate root causes of problems as they arise.

TECH AREA of EXCELLENCE

  1. Digital and Innovation contributor: Adopt innovation, engineering, and technology ensuring the transformation is recognized as an opportunity for excellence by:
    • Seeking opportunity to apply and encourage team to work with and use digital application where appropriate. Apply “use cases” to help team move forward to data driven approach.
    • Helping to build the foundations necessary for the transformation (data quality, competencies, organization, plant roadmap, collaboration with Site Digital Department).
    • Supporting and triggering projects and initiatives that will develop capabilities aligned with the Michelin strategy. Highlight the importance to copy/paste digital good practices.

Position Summary

The Data Strategy & Reporting Manager will lead the development, governance, and optimization of PHSU’s institutional data ecosystem. This role is responsible for collecting, cleaning, organizing, and integrating data from multiple university systems—including Jenzabar, Salesforce, Anthology, and Element451—into a centralized data warehouse or data lake solution. The position will ensure that data is accurate, accessible, and actionable for strategic, operational, and executive decision‑making across the institution. The ideal candidate blends strong technical skills with an ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional academic, enrollment, finance, and marketing teams. They will also create a consistent institutional reporting framework, including quarterly strategic updates, monthly performance dashboards, weekly operational metrics, and daily platform‑powered snapshots.

Data Integration & Architecture

  • Build and maintain data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Map data fields across systems and ensure standardized definitions and naming conventions.
  • Integrate new platforms and data sources as the ecosystem evolves.

Data Quality, Governance & Management

  • Clean, transform, and validate datasets.
  • Develop data governance policies, including data definitions, metadata, and stewardship standards.
  • Maintain data dictionaries and internal documentation.
  • Prevent data duplication and integrity issues across platforms.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Enrollment, Academics, Marketing, Finance, IT, and Institutional Research.
  • Lead sessions on data mapping and requirements gathering.

  • Provide training on dashboards, metrics, and definitions.

Reporting & Analytics Strategy

  • Build a standardized and scalable reporting ecosystem that includes:
    • Quarterly Strategic Report
    • Monthly Strategic Performance Report
    • Weekly Operational Report
    • Daily Reports
  • Design dashboards, scorecards, and automated reports using BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.).
  • Ensure real‑time visibility into KPIs and trends for leadership and teams.

Performance, Insights & Optimization

  • Build forecasting models and goal‑tracking frameworks.
  • Partner with Marketing to centralize investment, campaign, and channel‑performance data.
  • Continuously optimize data pipelines and integrations for speed and reliability.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking
  • Attention to detail
  • Problem‑solving
  • Technical expertise
  • Cross‑functional communication
  • Project management
  • Data visualization and storytelling
  • Accountability and follow‑through

Job description

Vaga na Área de Portaria. Empresa atuante na área de prestação de serviços de Portaria com mais de 18 anos de experiência no mercado.

Main responsibilities

O porteiro atuante em uma portaria de docas é responsável por controlar o acesso de pessoas, veículos e mercadorias, garantindo a segurança e a organização do fluxo logístico no local. Suas funções envolvem o acolhimento de visitantes e motoristas, verificação de documentos de entrada e saída, orientação sobre procedimentos internos e encaminhamento aos setores responsáveis.

Além dessas atribuições, o porteiro desempenha papel fundamental na mensageria , sendo responsável pelo recebimento de malotes, cartas e encomendas . Cabe a ele conferir os dados do remetente e destinatário, inspecionar as condições físicas dos volumes no momento da entrega, registrar o recebimento e assegurar a guarda adequada até a retirada pelos responsáveis.

Todas essas movimentações devem ser devidamente lançadas em sistema informatizado de controle , onde são inseridas informações como data e hora do recebimento, nome do entregador, conteúdo do pacote (se aplicável), e confirmação de entrega ao destinatário interno. Esse procedimento visa garantir rastreabilidade, transparência e segurança no fluxo de correspondências e encomendas corporativas.

Requirements and skills

Deverá ter Ensino Fundamental Completo, ter básico de computador: e-mail corporativo, digitação, planilhas (Excel), formulários digitais.

Habilidades Comportamentais e Técnicas:

  • Atenção a detalhes e organização no recebimento e registro de malotes e encomendas;
  • Pontualidade e responsabilidade no cumprimento de rotinas de segurança e mensageria;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita , para contato com entregadores, transportadoras e equipes internas;
  • Discrição e ética profissional , principalmente no manuseio de documentos sigilosos;
  • Proatividade para identificar e relatar inconsistências nos processos de recebimento e entrega;
  • Capacidade de trabalho sob pressão e em ambientes com grande fluxo logístico.

description:

Categoria: Vendas

Será responsável por realizar pequenas manutenções preventivas, instalações de sistemas de alarme, atender às necessidades dos clientes, preencher relatórios técnicos e realizar prospecção de novos clientes a partir de uma abordagem consultiva e estratégica.   1. Atuar de forma proativa buscando sempre atender as necessidades e expectativas de nossos clientes;
  2. Prospectar e gerir a carteira de clientes;
  3. Realizar manutenções preventivas de baixa complexidade em sistemas de alarme;
  4. Preencher relatórios de atendimento técnico e laudos técnicos;
  5. Preencher todas as documentações da rotina de um técnico de campo, como relatórios de deslocamento, prestação de contas e demais;
  6. Prospecção na rua para conseguir entrevistas com clientes potenciais e convertê-las em vendas;
  7. Manter relações comerciais positivas para garantir vendas futuras;
  8. Seguir a proposta e método de venda estabelecido pela Diretoria de Vendas;
  9. Apresentar e vender aos clientes as opções de aprimoramento do Kit básico e gama de serviços;
  10. Entregar a documentação em tempo e forma estabelecidas para faturamento;
  11. Realizar orçamentos para adição de dispositivos em sistemas de alarme já existentes;
  12. Realizar instalações de sistemas de alarme completos;
  13. Realizar instalações de novos dispositivos em sistemas de alarme já existentes.

O que esperamos do profissional?

  1. Formação: Ensino Médio Completo;
  2. Experiência em prospecção e negociação;
  3. Experiência com vendas consultivas;
  4. CNH Válida.

Principais habilidades:

  1. Ter visão ampla do mercado para encontrar as soluções mais assertivas para o cliente;
  2. Ser comunicativa e dinâmica, pois estará sempre em contato com o cliente;
  3. Ter visão estratégica para atender o cliente em suas especificidades.

O que oferecemos?

  1. Vale Refeição/Alimentação de R$ 29/dia;
  2. Remuneração Variável Mensal com base no plano de metas;
  3. Carro (desde o primeiro dia);
  4. Seguro de Vida Sulamérica;
  5. Plano de Assistência Médica AMIL;
  6. Plano Odontológico Sulamérica;
  7. Check-Up Anual Pluxee;
  8. Conexa – plataforma de telemedicina;
  9. Wellhub (Gympass);
  10. Empréstimo Consignado – conforme política vigente;
  11. Alarme Monitorado Verisure – conforme política vigente;
  12. Auxílio creche até 10 meses de idade – conforme política vigente;
  13. Bebê Verisure - um kit de presentes para os novos papais e mamães da Verisure;

title: Arquiteto de Soluções OSS
description:
Join to apply for the Arquiteto de Soluções OSS role at Grão Inteligência

Join to apply for the Arquiteto de Soluções OSS role at Grão Inteligência

  • Compartilhe
  • Compartilhe
  • Tweet
A Grão Inteligência é uma empresa de consultoria e tecnologia com sede no Brasil. Oferecemos soluções e serviços para otimizar a eficiência e a eficácia dos processos de negócios, abrangendo diversas áreas corporativas. Além disso, temos foco estratégico em soluções tecnológicas personalizadas, incluindo desenvolvimento e implantação de soluções de analytics.
Somos reconhecidos pela nossa experiência em fornecer insights e soluções que ajudam nossos clientes a enfrentar desafios complexos, melhorar o desempenho operacional, gerenciar riscos e aproveitar oportunidades de crescimento. Com mais de 10 anos de experiência, já trabalhamos com os mais diversos setores, incluindo varejo, bens de consumo, manufatura e serviços financeiros.
Se você é um acredita que tem o potencial de exercer alguma função na Grão Inteligência, seja você um jovem talento ou alguém mais experiente, se cadastre e deixe seu currículo na nossa base. Estruturamos as equipes dos nossos projetos de acordo com cada demanda individual e você pode ser exatamente o que precisamos!
Responsabilidades
  • Atuar em soluções de Telecomunicações conhecidas como OSS: Operations Support Systems;
conhecimentos em aprovisionamento, viabilidade, inventario de planta externa e de serviço,
gestão de ordens e soluções de força de campo (WFM);
  • Definir e implantar roadmap de integração;
  • Otimizar uso dos serviços e recursos tecnológicos existentes, assim como o desenvolvimento e
sustentação de serviços de alta performance;
  • Atuar na avaliação de soluções, identificando débitos técnicos, obsolescências, oportunidades
de adoção de novas soluções e manutenção das soluções disponíveis;
  • Auxiliar/orientar os desenvolvedores visando entregas ágeis e incrementais de soluções
escaláveis e tolerantes a falhas em conjunto com especialistas;
  • Definir arquitetura escalável, flexível e resiliente;
  • Auxiliar especialistas na verificação da viabilidade e necessidade de utilização de novas
tecnologias para desenvolvimento (front e back);
  • Monitorar o mercado para identificar tecnologias, startups e parceiros;
  • Manter e reportar o mapa/roadmap de arquitetura, apresentando as evoluções, riscos, débitos
técnicos da matriz.
  • Orientar e acompanhar projetos, a fim de garantir a aplicação das diretrizes de Arquitetura de
Soluções (visão integrada, negócio, aplicações, infraestrutura, segurança, integração)
executando tarefas;
  • Auxiliar na análise técnica de requisitos do projeto, mapeando os sistemas impactados e
auxiliando na definição da solução mais adequada de integração;
  • Apresentar tecnologias disponíveis e propor soluções para as demandas solicitadas,
acompanhar os projetos em desenvolvimento, para garantir a utilização da tecnologia mais
adequada;
  • Propor e avaliar ferramentas inovadoras para entregar a melhor experiência para os usuários;
  • Responsável pela análise, design e manutenção de desenhos de solução e de integração para
projetos;
  • Efetuar o acompanhamento das entregas durante o ciclo de desenvolvimento, testes e garantir
a entrega em produção;
  • Avaliar a solução AS-IS e desenhar a solução ToBe, elaborar documentos de arquitetura técnica
de Integração com a solução end-to-end das funcionalidades. Validar e confirmar a viabilidade
de implementação dos requisitos de negócio;
  • Garantir performance e segurança das soluções e serviços implementados nos projetos;
  • Colaborar com parceiros e usuários-chave na definição de soluções, buscando a melhor solução
que traga o menor impacto para o negócio
Requisitos
  • Ciências da Computação; Engenharia da Computação; Sistemas de Informação ou áreas
correlatas.
Hard skills
  • CI/CD (DEV/SEC/OPS); de Cloud Computing (AWS, OpenStack, Azure, Digital Ocean etc);
Weblogic; Docker e kubernetes;
  • Padrões de Projeto em JAVA; repositórios SVN/GIT e Nexus;
  • OSS Padrões estabelecidos pelo TMForum – Framework (TAM, TOM e Open APIs);
  • Arquiteturas de Integração de média e alta complexidade (REST, SOA, API Gateway,
Microservices);
  • Conhecimento em Open API, Swagger, Developer Portal;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de microserviços e tecnologias correlatas (OpenShift,
Kubernetes, Docker, Grafana, Jaeger, etc.);
  • Arquitetura Java EE;
  • Conhecimentos em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais (DDL, DML, transações, restrições de
integridade, índices, etc.);
  • Conhecimento de Arquiteturas Web, Portais, Middleware e Infraestrutura;
  • Conhecimento de Camadas arquiteturais (front-end, integração, back-end);
  • Conhecimento em DevOps, Jenkins e Nexus;
  • Conhecimento de repositórios SVN/GIT;
  • Conhecimento em soluções de inventário OpenLabs – Netwin;
  • Conhecimentos em soluções OSS de inventário de Planta Interna e Externa, como Granite,
Netwin, Ativação, WFM-Força de Campo;
  • Conhecimentos em soluções de OSM/Ordering (Oracle SOM);
  • Vivência com metodologia ágil.
Specific Tech
  • Conhecimento da plataforma Layer 7 API Gateway e Developer Portal da Broadcom;
  • Conhecimento em soluções de WFM Fiedl Service (Oracle Field Service / Salesforce Field
Service/Mulesoft; Netwin/NETQ);
  • Conhecimentos em soluções de georeferenciamento – Digicade GEOSITE.
Soft skills
  • Analítico
  • Autodidata
  • Autogestão
  • Boa comunicação
  • Dinâmico
Desejável
  • Inglês
  • Certificado Cloud

Se você é apaixonado pelo bem-estar e busca uma carreira com propósito, nossas oportunidades são para você!

O QUE BUSCAMOS? Profissionais com formação na área de saúde e bem estar, que acreditam em seu trabalho como um motor de transformação.

Responsabilidade Terapeuta Nossos(as) Terapeutas são responsáveis por executar protocolos de terapias corporais e faciais exclusivos da rede Buddha Spa descritos no menu de serviços tais como massagens relaxantes, shiatsu, drenagem, modeladora, limpeza de pele, massagem desportiva, ayurvédica, entre outras.

  • Esperamos que você tenha Formação nas áreas de Massoterapia, Fisioterapia, Estética, Naturologia, Naturopatia, Terapias Integrativas, Biomedicina, Enfermagem, Educação Física, Farmácia, somente com pós em Estética. Podem ser formações como cursos técnicos com mais de 200 horas ou graduações. Seria muito bacana se já tiver uma vivência em atendimentos.

O que oferecemos Ao ingressar na rede Buddha Spa, o profissional técnico passa por um importante processo de imersão, treinamento e preparação para estar apto a atuar no padrão de excelência da marca. Estas etapas envolvem:

  • Apresentação de boas-vindas e introdução ao mercado de bem-estar;
  • 104 horas de treinamento inicial de padronização e direcionamento nos protocolos técnicos, rituais de atendimento, treinamentos sobre produtos utilizados na experiência do cliente e direcionamento estratégico dos atendimentos em um centro de treinamento renomado Buddha College;
  • Vivência de aprendizado e aperfeiçoamento prático em unidade Buddha Spa;
  • Atualizações e treinamentos semanais através de plataforma EAD, com dicas, orientações de atendimento e tira dúvidas com a equipe de coordenação técnica da franqueadora;
  • Acesso a conteúdo permanente de treinamento e desenvolvimento em rede social corporativa Buddha Spa.

O Buddha Spa reconhece e valoriza todos os profissionais técnicos e parceiros da rede. Periodicamente realizamos premiações de desempenho e reconhecimentos, com viagens, experiências, passeios, restaurantes e participação em eventos/campeonatos internacionais do setor.

Se você é movido(a) por um comprometimento com o bem-estar e deseja fazer parte da nossa história, essa vaga é para você!

title: Sr. Data Analyst - NFL Universe Football
description:
Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. We are home to several of Roblox's top games, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football. With over 145 million monthly active players across our games, we are the #1 Roblox developer by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to more than 75 full‑time remote team members across the globe.

Our strategy is to acquire and sustainably grow games on Roblox. Our acquisition strategy is backed with significant capital from firms including The Raine Group, Makers Fund, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), QIA, Dune Ventures, and MIT.

Our top games include:

  • Brookhaven – #1 role‑play game on Roblox and the most popular game on the platform
  • Driving Empire – #1 driving game on Roblox where we’ve brought real cars into the game in partnership with automakers
  • NFL Universe Football – #1 American football game and top grossing sports game on Roblox

About the role

Voldex is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our high‑impact data team. In this role, you’ll go beyond reporting – you’ll uncover critical insights that shape the future of our games and influence millions of players. You’ll partner cross‑functionally with Product, Game Design, and Marketing to drive game strategy, optimise the player experience, and deliver measurable improvements through experimentation.

This is a senior‑level role, ideal for someone who thrives on solving complex problems, building data tools, and turning insights into action.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze billions of rows of gameplay and player behaviour data to identify growth and retention opportunities
  • Own end‑to‑end design and analysis of A/B tests, from hypothesis creation to rollout recommendation
  • Build automated, scalable dashboards in Tableau that are used daily by Product and Game teams
  • Drive product development with insightful, story‑driven analysis that influences roadmap decisions
  • Partner with Game Design and Engineering to implement new features and ensure data integrity
  • Segment and model user behaviour to understand different player types and their impact on monetisation
  • Analyze the impact of our partnerships from licensing & marketing partners
  • Contribute to data modelling and pipeline improvements using dbt and SQL
  • Proactively prioritise high‑impact projects in a fast‑paced, iterative development environment

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, with at least 2+ years in gaming
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and data visualization (ideally Tableau)
  • Experience with A/B testing design, execution, and interpretation
  • Strong product intuition and an ability to turn data into a clear, compelling narrative
  • Familiarity with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred)
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort presenting findings to both technical and non‑technical teams
  • Comfortable working independently, with a bias for action and experimentation

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Roblox or other UGC platforms
  • Proficiency in Python for analysis or automation
  • Understanding of player segmentation, LTV modelling, and funnel diagnostics
  • Experience working on live service games or mobile F2P products

Hands‑on experience with dbt and working with structured datasets

We look for candidates who can confidently build and maintain data pipelines, transform data, and create reusable models.

Voldex is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation – above‑market salary + profit sharing + stock options
  • Retirement benefits – company contribution to your retirement plan (401k, RRSP, Pension) in Canada, UK and USA
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits – varying by country with additional benefits such as life, ADD, etc.
  • Flexible PTO – vacations + federal / bank holidays
  • Remote first – we are remote and will remain that way including work from home or anywhere
  • In‑person get‑togethers, virtual company‑wide game events, Robux allowances, and more
  • Professional development – reimbursement of courses, materials, and other training costs
  • Work with awesome people and impact millions of daily players

title: Senior Project Development Manager, Brazil - Battery Storage
description:
Company Overview

Plus Power is an energy storage market leader, with a market‑leading 10+ GW portfolio across more than 25 states that will transform North American electric grids into cleaner and more versatile critical infrastructure.

About the Role

Plus Power recruits outstanding energy industry professionals who are driven to develop, build and operate assets safely and reliably to decarbonize the power markets while growing their careers. Our team looks for data‑driven and fact‑based mindsets, engaging and collaborative behaviors, and personal growth‑focused professionals.

Plus Power is looking to hire a Project Development Senior Manager to be a functional lead of projects within Plus Power's portfolio. The Project Development Senior Manager will own the ultimate responsibility for de‑risking a portfolio of projects in Brazil. The Project Development Manager will have a sophisticated team of subject matter experts who will provide support for specific discrete deliverables such as cost estimates, interconnection process navigation, procurement and operations, however the ultimate responsibility of this position is to lead a cross‑functional team to bring a portfolio of projects to Notice to Proceed (NTP).

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with local Brazilian partners to ensure workflow is efficient and expeditiously completed.
  • Site Acquisition and Due Diligence: Partner with stakeholders to identify and secure project sites that maximize off‑take potential, ensuring adherence to internal processes and completion of diligence requirements.
  • Project Development: Manage a project pipeline and execute on complex milestone deliverables across a network of stakeholders.
  • Project Management: Own complex site, permitting, and technology problem‑solving efforts, leveraging internal expertise and external stakeholder engagement to keep projects on track.
  • Project Finance: Understand the key financing elements of a project and work with the finance and commercial teams to ensure that all projects and deals continue to meet or exceed financial hurdles.
  • Contract Origination: Partner with Markets and Origination teams to identify and quantify commercial opportunities and support RFP submissions.
  • Commercial Negotiation: Support cross‑functional stakeholders in negotiating power purchase agreements, permitting documents, interconnection agreements, and related commercial contracts to protect project and development objectives; support financing activities associated with new deals.
  • Deal Execution: Provide support in closing and financing each new deal.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Minimum BA/BS in economics, finance, business, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in project development focused on transmission‑connected generators in Brazil.
  • Preference is for this role to be based in Brazil.
  • Familiarity with the Brazilian power market, ONS and EPE rules and dynamics.
  • Experience supporting full lifecycle development of a transmission‑connected generation asset in Brazil.
  • Experience participating in the development of or completing all of the following agreement types:
  • • Site lease or purchase agreements
  • • Site Plan and Building Permit approvals
  • • Interconnection agreements
  • • Power purchase or tolling agreements
  • • MIPA / PSA for project disposition / acquisition
  • Creative independent thinker; demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse team.
  • Adept at working collaboratively and effectively in a cross‑functional environment with both technical and non‑technical team members who are geographically dispersed.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects in a dynamic, fast paced environment.
  • Ability to think creatively, bringing innovative ideas and solutions to complex challenges.
  • Highly organized with impeccable attention to detail.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and deliver timely, high‑quality results.Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and confidently to diverse audiences, including senior leadership and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to travel as needed to successfully advance and contract a portfolio of projects, including stakeholder meetings, site visits, and related activities.

Compensation, Location, and Benefits

Highly competitive total compensation from one of North America's leading energy storage developers, owners and operators. Flexible, work from home or hybrid work from Plus Power's offices in San Francisco, Houston, Chicago, Seattle, and Palm Beach.

We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range based on several factors including, but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, geographic labor market, and other factors consistent with applicable law. This position is also eligible to participate in our annual bonus program.

Plus Power offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits program, unlimited vacation, flexible remote work, work from home stipend, educational assistance, parental leave, and a highly engaging company culture with opportunities for in‑person connection and learning and growth.

The deadline for applying to this role is 1/05/2026.

Plus Power is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds can thrive. Plus Power is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: Enterprise Sales Manager
description:
Enterprise Sales Manager

Job Purpose

The Enterprise Sales Manager is responsible for driving new revenue growth through proactive outreach, prospecting, and pipeline development, while also expanding existing enterprise customer relationships. Leads will be generated through multiple channels, including marketing campaigns, third‑party lead generation, and self‑sourced outreach.

An Enterprise customer is defined as any organisation with 200+ white‑collar employees, and the role will span both national and international client requirements, depending on account footprint and opportunity scope.

This role plays a critical part in positioning IWG’s full suite of solutions to large organisations across multiple markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate profitable new revenue by identifying, prospecting, and converting new Enterprise clients.
  • Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified sales opportunities across multiple sectors and geographies.
  • Conduct strategic outreach through direct engagement, events, and third‑party referrals to identify high‑potential prospects.
  • Own the full sales cycle — from first contact to close — with an emphasis on front‑end activity and deal progression.
  • Create and execute Account Plans to grow wallet share within assigned strategic accounts.
  • Build and maintain executive‑level relationships to gain insight into client needs and translate insights into tailored workspace solutions.
  • Collaborate with brokers, real estate advisors, and consultants to generate opportunities and increase IWG’s market visibility.
  • Partner cross‑functionally with regional Sales, Operations, and Product teams to ensure seamless solution delivery.
  • Continuously gather and share feedback from prospects and clients to improve product‑market fit and go‑to‑market effectiveness.
  • Deliver accurate pipeline forecasts, activity reports, and performance updates.

Required Skills, Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven track record in B2B prospecting, business development, and solution selling.
  • Ability to independently source and qualify leads in complex, consultative sales environments.
  • Strong understanding of the enterprise customer buying journey and long‑cycle deal management.
  • Experience working with and influencing C‑level stakeholders.
  • Background in commercial real estate, enterprise services, or flexible workspace is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet and exceed sales targets through self‑generated pipeline.
  • Strong negotiation and contract structuring skills.
  • High level of commercial acumen and results orientation.
  • Comfortable working in global, matrixed organisations with distributed teams.
  • Adaptable, proactive, and confident navigating ambiguity.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as needed.
  • Native Portuguese and fluent/conversational English

About the company

IWG has been at the forefront of flexible working for more than 30 years. With over 3,500 locations around the globe, spanning brands including Regus, Spaces, Signature and HQ, we have made it possible for businesses of all sizes to make the transition to hybrid working, empowering employees to work wherever and whenever is most convenient.

We help more than 8 million people and their businesses to work more productively, supported by a choice of professional, inspiring and collaborative workspaces, communities and services.

As the world’s leading provider of hybrid work solutions, with four times the number of locations compared to its nearest competitor, IWG is already working with over 80% of the Fortune 500 and counts businesses including Amazon, Netflix, EY and Uber amongst its customers.

Companies of all sizes are shifting to flexible working to lower costs, improve employee retention and lower their carbon emissions. The flexible workspace is expected to grow by 600% by 2023, when 30% of all office space will be hybrid. We are growing our network faster than ever to keep up with demand from customers as we work towards our goal of reaching 30,000 centres.

Carbon Neutral Workplaces

IWG’s purpose of helping everyone have a great day at work, while protecting people and the planet is at the heart of everything we do. We are proud to supply all of our customers worldwide with carbon neutral workplaces, and we have a strong climate action plan in place to help us achieve our objective of Net Zero emissions by 2040.

Leading Employer Award IWG is proud to be the recipient of a Leading Employer Award in 2022, 2023, 2024 & 2025. Awarded exclusively to the top 1% of employers, the accolade is testament to our diverse global workforce and the role everyone plays in bringing our purpose, culture and values to life, every single day.

This is a full-time hybrid position for a Regional Sales Manager based in Rio de Janeiro, RJ. The role includes both remote work and regular in-office presence as needed.

As Regional Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving commercial growth and managing client relationships across the LATAM South Cone region. A key part of this role is leading the regional Sales, Support, and Technical teams, ensuring alignment, motivation, and performance across functions. You will play a critical role in setting priorities, guiding execution, and fostering collaboration between departments.

  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.

Nice to Have

  • Demonstrated leadership and team management skills — experience supervising cross‑functional or commercial teams.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on Cutting‑Edge Technology in seismic interpretation & subsurface analysis.
  • Be Part of a Global Team with colleagues across Europe, the Americas and beyond.

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. Our Editors add immense value to our client's work through native content and strategies. The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate about using their editing skills to tell a compelling story and help our customers grow their businesses.

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Fundada em 2001, a Contagem Inventários é referência nacional em prestação de serviços de inventário de estoques para o varejo. title: ANALISTA SISTEMAS - HOSPITAL CARDOSO FONTES
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04 / 03 / 1966, 40.103 de 17 / 05 / 1962 e 8.911, de 30 / 07 / 1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia da Computação, Ciências da Computação e áreas afins. Pós-Graduação na área de atuação.

Experiência de 6 meses na função.

Ser responsável pelo alinhamento entre as áreas de negócios e Tecnologia e Informação. Oferecer suporte aos usuários quanto ao uso de sistemas. Realizar análises e correções em sistemas. Analisar as solicitações e acompanhamento das empresas terceirizadas. Dimensionar requisitos e funcionalidades do sistema. Desenvolver relatórios a partir dos bancos de dados dos sistemas.

Além de realizar a aplicação de todos os nossos protocolos de estética e bem-estar, os profissionais técnicos Buddha Spa são responsáveis por entregar o bem-estar de forma ampla, atuando em todos os aspectos de rituais de atendimento e experiência do cliente dentro de cabine.

Ao ingressar na rede Buddha Spa, o profissional técnico passa por um importante processo de imersão, treinamento e preparação para estar apto a atuar no padrão de excelência da marca.

Horário de trabalho: O profissional atua em média 7 horas por dia, com uma folga fixa durante a semana e um sábado fixo de folga. Aos domingos, o trabalho é feito por escala, normalmente dois domingos no mês.

Contratação: Realizamos contrato de parceria com a terapeuta, via Lei do Salão Parceiro (Lei 13.352/2016). Você deverá abrir um MEI/CNPJ.

Remuneração: Remuneração através de repartição de resultados dos atendimentos, ou seja, recebem uma porcentagem em cima dos procedimentos realizados.

Possuímos um importante plano de crescimento e incentivo. São inúmeros benefícios trazidos de acordo com o tempo de parceria e crescimento em nossa escala de desenvolvimento.

  • Bronze – 20%
  • Prata – 25%
  • Ouro – 30%
  • Diamante – 35%

O Buddha Spa é a maior rede de Spas Urbanos do país, com unidades em diversas cidades e estados. Nossas unidades estão localizadas em imóveis de rua, dentro de hotéis, condomínios, shoppings, salões e academias, sempre buscando nos aproximar de nossos clientes.

Com foco em serviços de bem-estar, relaxamento e estética, oferecemos mais de 25 tipos de terapias, desde massagens corporais, banhos, tratamentos estéticos avançados, Day Spas, além de procedimentos exclusivamente voltados para o público masculino, gestantes e pós-parto.

A essência do trabalho do Buddha Spa se assenta nos valores do “sentir-se bem”, em todos os aspectos. Buscamos entregar a nossos clientes muito mais do que o atendimento técnico de cada serviço, propiciando uma experiência única. O despertar dos 5 sentidos é a base do atendimento de nossos clientes, os quais usufruem de uma infra-estrutura de alto padrão totalmente voltada para o bem-estar: sons, aromas e chás complementam o toque profissional de cada um de nossos terapeutas.

title: Analista de Dados - Botafogo/RJ
description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.
Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.
Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.
SOBRE A VAGA
A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.
Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.
Nesse papel você será responsável por ajudar equipes pedagógicas, alunos e famílias a utilizarem tecnologias de forma eficiente em suas aulas, bem como por gerenciar e manter os softwares pedagógicos da escola.
RESPONSABILIDADES
O que você fará:

  • Ajudar os professores a utilizar tecnologias educacionais, incluindo ferramentas de aprendizado online, software de gerenciamento de aulas e outras tecnologias;
  • Fornecer suporte técnico e responder chamados de professores, famílias e alunos, resolvendo problemas relacionados aos software e tecnologia educacional de maneira rápida e eficiente;
  • Gerenciar e manter os sistemas tecnológicos da escola atualizados;
  • Capacitar professores e funcionários em novas tecnologias e ferramentas;
  • Participar ativamente dos eventos e rotinas pedagógicas da escola, com ideias de inovação ou complementação tecnológica.
Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.
REQUISITOS
O que você precisa ter:
  • Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia, Design, Pedagogia, Engenharia, TI ou áreas afins;
  • Inglês intermediário (conversação) e avançado (leitura);
  • Experiência com as ferramentas Google for Education (Classroom, Docs, Sheets, Slides, etc);
  • Vivência com atendimento presencial e atendimento de chamados;
  • Experiência com tecnologias educacionais e dispositivos como iPads, Sphero, etc;
  • Certificação de Educador Google Nível 1.
Será um diferencial se você tiver:
  • Certificação de Educador Google Nível 2 e Trainer, e semelhantes;
  • Conhecimento de Metodologias Ativas, Cultura Maker e Design Thinking;
  • Familiaridade com softwares de gerenciamento de dados, acervo e chamados (iSAMS, ServiceDesk+, AgendaEdu, Seesaw);
  • Experiência em escolas ou outros ambientes educacionais.
Você vai se encaixar bem se tiver:
  • Inteligência emocional para lidar com diferentes públicos (alunos, colaboradores administrativos, colaboradores pedagógicos);
  • Postura colaborativa voltada para solução de problemas;
  • Ser organizado, proativo e estar sempre disposto a sair da zona de conforto.
SAFEGUARDING STATEMENT
O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: Compliance Analyst
description:
About Crown

We exist to make money work better. That means eliminating the friction of integrating the Brazilian Real into the blockchain economy without sacrificing trust, safety, or compliance.

With the conviction that programmable money is the future of finance, we built BRLV . Anchored by a 1:1 backing of sovereign Brazilian treasury assets, BRLV is the safe, scalable settlement layer designed for the tokenized economy.

We’re backed by Framework, Valor, Norte, Coinbase Ventures, Paxos, and Nubank co‑founder Ed Wible. Our goal: R$1 trillion of BRLV in circulation within 10 years.

The Role

As a Compliance Analyst at Crown, you will be a cornerstone of our risk management framework, operating across both the first and second lines of defense. You will serve as the primary compliance liaison for our institutional clients and partners, guiding them through our rigorous due diligence process while performing critical risk analysis to protect the firm. This role requires a unique blend of client‑facing communication skills and deep analytical rigor. You will work directly with the Chief Compliance Officer and the broader risk function to implement and uphold our institutional‑grade AML/CFT Policy.

  • Institutional Onboarding (1st Line): Act as the main point of contact for institutional clients during the entire onboarding lifecycle. You will guide them through the appropriate Due Diligence Questionnaire (for Brazilian, U.S., or other non‑U.S. entities), ensuring all mandatory documentation—such as constitutional documents, AML/CFT policies, and ownership charts—is collected completely and accurately.
  • Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Risk Assessment (2nd Line): Conduct comprehensive reviews of prospective clients, applying our risk‑based approach. This includes analyzing complex corporate structures to identify and verify Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) according to our dynamic thresholds.
  • Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Execute enhanced due diligence for high‑risk clients, including Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), VASPs, and other financial institutions. This involves a critical assessment of the client’s own AML program, their independent audit reports, and the source of their funds and wealth.
  • Transaction Monitoring Support (2nd Line): Assist in the analysis of alerts generated by our on‑chain and fiat transaction monitoring systems. You will investigate atypical activity, adhering to strict internal SLAs for resolution (e.g., 24 hours for critical alerts), and prepare dossiers for potential Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to be submitted to COAF.
  • Record Keeping and Data Protection: Ensure all due diligence, risk assessments, and client communications are meticulously documented and securely stored, in compliance with our policies and regulatory requirements. You will handle highly sensitive client data and must adhere strictly to our Information Security Policy and data protection principles (LGPD).

You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You have 3+ years of experience in a compliance, KYC/AML, risk, or client onboarding role within a VASP, fintech, or regulated financial institution.
  • You have a deep and practical understanding of Brazilian AML/CFT regulations (e.g., Law 14.478/22, COAF reporting) and are familiar with international FATF standards.
  • You are fluent in both Portuguese and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills required to interact with sophisticated institutional clients and internal stakeholders.
  • You have a highly analytical mindset and an obsessive attention to detail, capable of dissecting complex legal and corporate structures to identify underlying risks.
  • You thrive in ownership-driven environments. You’re highly accountable for your work and don’t require others following up on it.
  • You naturally operate cross-functionally, with strong collaborative instincts toward legal, operations, and technology teams.
  • You are energized by the challenge of building and refining compliance processes from the ground up in a fast-paced environment.

What’s Different About Working Here

  • Small by design. We don’t hire layers of managers. Everyone builds.
  • Ownership is total. You own the function end‑to‑end—and ask for input when it makes the work better, not because someone’s checking.
  • Ruthlessly simple. We don’t paper over complexity with process or headcount.
  • Collaboration is default. Problems are shared property. We work across domains.
  • Feedback is candid and direct. Built on the assumption that everyone here is smart, competent, and cares.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary
  • Full health coverage
  • VA

description:
1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.

We're looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting
  • Maintain up-to-date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team

Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming)
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services)
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses — to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.
